Create a scene of a remote science-fiction power installation on an open expanse of dark metallic ground under cool daylight. Place a tall science-fiction tower at the center of the installation, with two smaller towers behind it. Form low, uneven mounds along the rear and both sides of the site while leaving the front open. Keep a broad, clear approach across the ground from the open front to the central tower. Arrange generators in a compact group to the right of the central tower. Run curved metal pipes between the generators and the base of that tower, and cluster additional pipe sections beside the generators. Place power-line units behind the generator group, with cords lying near their bases. Set a metal statue to the left of the approach, separated from the machinery. Give the ground and equipment a weathered metallic appearance with restrained glowing accents. Keep the central tower visually dominant, with the smaller towers, mounds, and grouped machinery framing the open approach.
